name: noise-keynote
about: NOISE for the keynote board: paper tiles (ground day #f2f4ee) on the deep sage canvas (#e3e8df), deep-sage plate tiles, one lime accent, Bricolage Grotesque labels and the condensed display cut for the hero. Flat colour only: the brand forbids gradients, glows and shadows and red or green outside the ARPG ground, so app icons are flat squircles and brand marks are one-colour glyphs. Rounded, gapped tiles are the approved bento exception (2026-10-11).
